name: Schwarzschild Radius
description: Compute the Schwarzschild radius r_s = 2GM/c² — the event horizon radius of a non-rotating black hole. Pairs naturally with the Hawking temperature model: both take mass M as input, both use G and c from the CODATA table. Together they define the black hole's two most fundamental observable properties. SI_CHECK verifies the output unit is metres. For a solar-mass black hole: r_s ≈ 2.95 km. For Earth's mass: r_s ≈ 8.87 mm.
author: system

pipeline.note: Dimensional check: result unit must be m

validation: M = M_sun → r_s ≈ 2954 m. M = M_earth (5.972×10²⁴ kg) → r_s ≈ 0.00887 m. r_s ∝ M: linear in mass.
companion_model: hawking_temperature — same inputs (M, G, c), complementary outputs (r_s and T). A black hole is fully characterised by these two numbers.
